app_name: هيبة / HEEBA — PUBG Rewards & Lucky Wheel
personality: 7 Dark-First Utility layout + 6 Glass / Luxe depth (Gaming & Military Fusion)
personality_one_liner: A premium, tactical command-center that feels like an elite battle royale lobby—dark, metallic, and illuminated by fiery gold and neon rarity glows.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around elements (lg=16px) but rigid structural grids. Use 2-column or 3-column structured layouts to accommodate dense gaming stats.

do's: Apply frosted glass (expo-blur) over the dark military background for all main cards, headers, and bottom tabs.
Pair blur with a translucent #1A1A22 tint underneath at >70% opacity to ensure text remains perfectly readable.
Use glass to create depth between the 'Lobby Background' and the interactive UI elements.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Do not use glass without a dark tint underneath; the background battle/smoke graphics will make text unreadable without it.

soldier_hero_bg.alt: Dark cinematic 3D render of a futuristic military soldier silhouette standing in smoke and battlefield debris, PUBG style, glowing orange and gold accents, high contrast, portrait crop

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce Arabic RTL layout where applicable, but keep numbers and English co-branding (HEEBA) in LTR format using the 'Rajdhani' font for a technical, gaming feel.
Use 'Cairo' for all Arabic body and UI text as it is a highly legible and modern sans-serif.

Rarity Tiers Implementation: You MUST use these specific colors for borders, badges, and glows to denote rarity: Common (#9E9E9E), Rare (#00BFA5), Epic (#8E24AA), Legendary (#FFD700 with shadow glow). Do NOT use default colors for rarity items.

Glassmorphism is crucial here. Use `expo-blur` heavily on cards (especially the Home Lobby) to sit on top of the 'military_texture_bg' image, but ALWAYS pair it with a dark `#1A1A22` overlay at 75% opacity to guarantee text contrast.
Never use Indigo, Blue, or Purple for primary UI elements. The only exception is Purple (#8E24AA) strictly for the 'Epic' rarity tier. Base UI is metallic dark grays with Gold/Orange action colors.
For the hero login screen, if the image URL is 'fallback', use the image_generation_tool with the provided alt text to generate the soldier hero image.

Use a token-based layout: all cards should either be full-width (minus screen padding) or sit in a strict 2-column wrapping grid (`justifyContent: space-between`, gap `md`). Do not let cards sit awkwardly at 48% with no spacing.
Ensure the CTA on the Login screen and the Spin button on the Wheel screen use the `brandPrimary` (#F5A623) color with a tactile, heavy feel (shadow tier 2 or 3).
